## Declarations and implementations

```plato

    //==
    // Construction

    // The rotation of `angle` about `axis`, following the right-hand rule:
    // (axis sin(angle/2), cos(angle/2)). Precondition: `axis` is a unit vector.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axis%E2%80%93angle_representation
    CreateFromAxisAngle(_: Quaternion, axis: Vector3D, angle: Angle): Quaternion {
        var h = angle * 0.5;
        var s = h.Sin;
        return (axis.X * s, axis.Y * s, axis.Z * s, h.Cos);
    }

    // The rotation of the three Tait-Bryan angles, applied roll then pitch then
    // yaw (yaw about Y, pitch about X, roll about Z).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conversion_between_quaternions_and_Euler_angles
    CreateFromYawPitchRoll(_: Quaternion, yaw: Angle, pitch: Angle, roll: Angle): Quaternion {
        var hr = roll * 0.5;
        var hp = pitch * 0.5;
        var hy = yaw * 0.5;
        var sr = hr.Sin;
        var cr = hr.Cos;
        var sp = hp.Sin;
        var cp = hp.Cos;
        var sy = hy.Sin;
        var cy = hy.Cos;
        return (cy * sp * cr + sy * cp * sr,
                sy * cp * cr - cy * sp * sr,
                cy * cp * sr - sy * sp * cr,
                cy * cp * cr + sy * sp * sr);
    }

    // The quaternion of a rotation matrix, taking whichever of the four branches
    // has the numerically largest component so the shared divisor is never small.
    // Precondition: the upper 3x3 block is orthonormal (no scale or shear).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotation_matrix#Quaternion
    CreateFromRotationMatrix(_: Quaternion, matrix: Matrix4x4): Quaternion {
        var m11 = matrix.Row1.X;
        var m22 = matrix.Row2.Y;
        var m33 = matrix.Row3.Z;
        return m11 + m22 + m33 > 0.0
            ? matrix.QuaternionFromTrace
            : (m11 >= m22 && m11 >= m33
                ? matrix.QuaternionFromLargestX
                : (m22 > m33
                    ? matrix.QuaternionFromLargestY
                    : matrix.QuaternionFromLargestZ));
    }

    // The positive-trace branch of CreateFromRotationMatrix: W is the largest
    // component. Precondition: M11 + M22 + M33 > 0.
    QuaternionFromTrace(m: Matrix4x4): Quaternion {
        var s = (m.Row1.X + m.Row2.Y + m.Row3.Z + 1.0).Sqrt;
        var invS = 0.5 / s;
        return ((m.Row2.Z - m.Row3.Y) * invS,
                (m.Row3.X - m.Row1.Z) * invS,
                (m.Row1.Y - m.Row2.X) * invS,
                s * 0.5);
    }

    // The branch of CreateFromRotationMatrix taken when X is the largest component.
    QuaternionFromLargestX(m: Matrix4x4): Quaternion {
        var s = (1.0 + m.Row1.X - m.Row2.Y - m.Row3.Z).Sqrt;
        var invS = 0.5 / s;
        return (0.5 * s,
                (m.Row1.Y + m.Row2.X) * invS,
                (m.Row1.Z + m.Row3.X) * invS,
                (m.Row2.Z - m.Row3.Y) * invS);
    }

    // The branch of CreateFromRotationMatrix taken when Y is the largest component.
    QuaternionFromLargestY(m: Matrix4x4): Quaternion {
        var s = (1.0 + m.Row2.Y - m.Row1.X - m.Row3.Z).Sqrt;
        var invS = 0.5 / s;
        return ((m.Row2.X + m.Row1.Y) * invS,
                0.5 * s,
                (m.Row3.Y + m.Row2.Z) * invS,
                (m.Row3.X - m.Row1.Z) * invS);
    }

    // The branch of CreateFromRotationMatrix taken when Z is the largest component.
    QuaternionFromLargestZ(m: Matrix4x4): Quaternion {
        var s = (1.0 + m.Row3.Z - m.Row1.X - m.Row2.Y).Sqrt;
        var invS = 0.5 / s;
        return ((m.Row3.X + m.Row1.Z) * invS,
                (m.Row3.Y + m.Row2.Z) * invS,
                0.5 * s,
                (m.Row1.Y - m.Row2.X) * invS);
    }
}
```
